snapshotMetadata.limitations: Static offline reference snapshot generated from verified MongoDB observations. Does not reflect real-time atmospheric dynamics.

rainfall.total_policy: total_mm is the sum of valid observed days. Missing days are not imputed. total_kind is complete_period_total only when every expected calendar day is valid. is_complete remains the 90 percent eligibility flag for historical distributions and can still include a period that is missing days. coverage_percent is the stored-row rate for this rainfall series only; calendar_coverage uses the calendar days in years present in the payload.

temperature.coverage_note: coverage_percent combines stored rows for T2M, T2M_MAX, and T2M_MIN when those series are supplied. It is not a rainfall coverage figure. Use coverage_by_parameter for one variable.

meta.limitations: NASA POWER Local Solar Time (LST) observations. Gridded point interpolation resolution ~0.5 deg. Descriptive historical statistics only. No predictive crop yield or sowing guarantees.
